resolvedReviewFindings.finding: Inventory anchors alone located OS mode and delivery but did not bind the actual builder call.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Scopes actual intent.perform and makeCommand, binds currentMode==foreground to runsInForeground, builder argument, continueInForeground and delivery.canPresentUI. Constant true/canContinue-only substitutes are negative cases.

resolvedReviewFindings.finding: The intermediate9570 gate validated named run/reporter declarations but could leave them as dead helpers if perform called another execution path.
resolvedReviewFindings.resolution: Scopes executor and operation closure; binds captured original OS Progress, product store, executor.execute(command), ownedCommand and both existing OS operation wrappers into the actual MiniAppsShortcutExecution.run call. Targeted call/command/store/progress/wrapper substitutions are negative cases.

finalVerifiedSourceChain: Actual OS currentMode determines command UI delivery.
Actual intent executor supplies the owned command and captured Progress through both existing OS branches.
The local child platform captures the newly constructed reporter for that command/store.
Reporter admission checks a running receipt and unexpired lease, and retains its command and lease IDs.
Every receive requires exact miniapps.shortcutProgress, running matching live lease, noncancelled receipt and nonclosed Progress.
The typed payload is decoded and validated before its counts are written.
The same child executes the claimed command; defer closes the reporter and clears its callback.
